program_description: A community-based economic empowerment program that provides women with entrepreneurship training, basic financial literacy, business planning support, and peer mentoring to strengthen small-scale livelihood opportunities.

target_beneficiaries.primary: Women from rural and underserved communities interested in starting or strengthening small businesses

activities: Deliver entrepreneurship and financial literacy training
Support participants in developing business plans
Track participant completion and business-planning outcomes

evidence.source: Women Forward Community Initiative 2025 Program Impact Report
